title: Quaint Juicy French Pork Blanquette
description: A traditional French dish from Brittany featuring tender pork in a rich wine sauce, served with a crusty bun.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the pork pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the pork and vegetables, stirring to combine.
Gradually add the white wine and chicken broth, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the blanquette with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the blanquette hot, garnished with chopped parsley and accompanied by a crusty bun.
